rules: Read AI_BLUEPRINT.md before making repository changes.
Follow AGENTS.md for AI-agent operating instructions.
Treat AI_BLUEPRINT.md as the only canonical product and technical plan.
Historical roadmaps, blueprints, TODOs, coordination records, and reports are reference material only unless explicitly incorporated into AI_BLUEPRINT.md.
Inspect existing code before creating new architecture or duplicating functionality.
Prefer integration and cleanup over parallel competing implementations.
Keep the repository organized by responsibility and remove obsolete duplication when safe.
Build production functionality continuously; do not stop for a testing campaign.
Testing and final validation are deferred until the development-complete phase.

agent_roles.lead_orchestrator: Coordinate work against AI_BLUEPRINT.md and prevent conflicting implementations.
agent_roles.core_development: Implement and integrate core Windows-AI functionality.
agent_roles.api_development: Implement and integrate API, SDK, and service interfaces.
agent_roles.plugin_development: Implement plugin, marketplace, and extension capabilities.
agent_roles.performance: Optimize implementation when it directly advances production readiness.
agent_roles.documentation: Keep canonical documentation synchronized with implemented behavior.
